integrity: The proof is analytic and reconstructs the new upper bound directly from the exact variational representation; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the exponential rate but not the optimal polynomial prefactor, a full asymptotic equivalent for the sharp profile constant, or the maximizing-profile asymptotics. It applies only to the slab and functional classes and normalizations of the cited source.
title: The sharp slab Santaló advantage has exact exponential base two
